name: cable132
source: UK Power Networks Appendix A Schedule of Technical Particulars, detailed reply, 1x1600 132 kV HDPE, 2018
attribution: values from the manufacturer's completed schedule; no table reproduced, only the values this drawing uses
law: every value read from the UK Power Networks schedule of technical particulars, detailed reply, 1x1600 132 kV HDPE: 50.3 over conductor, 53.3 over conductor screen, 17 mm XLPE, 89.0 over insulation screen, 0.35 swellable tape, 68 ALUMINIUM wires of 2.00 mm, 94.5 over metallic screen, 0.29 foil, 95.7 over foil, 4.2 HDPE, 104.0 overall; layers filled with rings so dust distributes by thickness, because the engine has no per point brightness; every layer is inset from its neighbours so a dark boundary separates it, and density follows material: metal dense, polymer airy

inputs.screen_material: ALUMINIUM wire (item 14: copper wire screen / earth conductor, AL wire)
